messages:
incident-bot: P0 page to @olivia (oncall): Increased 99th-percentile generation latency observed in eu-west-1 hosted inference fleet. Error rate not elevated. Auto-fallbacks triggered for ~12% of requests. Investigating.

olivia (oncall): seeing it. jumping in now. any scope on impacted models or customers?

sam (sre): observability: spike started at 09:12 UTC. CPU on some workers hitting sustained 95%. Network retransmits slightly up. Model variants v2-quant and v2-fp16 affected. Linking traces.

maya (product): queue: large customers with streaming enabled may see delays >5s on tail tokens. non-streaming completions mostly OK.

olivia (oncall): initial triage: throttle autoscaler paused on a subset of Dedicated nodes in eu cluster — suspect a deploy that reduced available cores. triggering rollback of last infra change.

sam (sre): rollback initiated. rolling restarts of affected workers. ETA ~6–8 mins to steady state.

jordan (commops): need statuspage copy. initial message should say we're investigating and mention potential increased latency in EU region. non-critical customers might see degraded tail latency. draft below:

jordan (commops): ```Initial: We are investigating increased generation latency affecting some requests in our EU region. Customers may experience longer tail latencies (>5s) for streaming outputs. Our on-call team is rolling back a recent infra change and monitoring to restore normal performance.``` 

rita (cs): suggest adding guidance: "If you rely on strict latency SLAs, consider switching to Dedicated capacity or pin to non-streaming endpoints for now." keep it short.

lee (legal): avoid promising rollback or specific timings. suggest: "Our team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations to restore normal service."

jordan (commops): updated draft with legal wording:

jordan (commops): ```Initial: We are investigating increased generation latency affecting some requests in our EU region. Customers may experience increased tail latencies for streaming outputs. Our team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations to restore normal service. We will post updates here.``` 

olivia (oncall): +1. include ETA for next update in ~10m. put "Next update: in 10 minutes" at end.

jordan (commops): final initial publish copy:

jordan (commops): ```We are investigating increased generation latency for some requests in the EU region. Some streaming responses may experience higher tail latency. Our team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations to restore normal service. Next update: in ~10 minutes.``` 

maya (product): approved for posting.

jordan (commops): publishing to statuspage now and sending customer email to affected list (CS will coordinate). posting link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-2026-eu-latency

incident-bot: statuspage published by jordan at 09:18 UTC: rdw-2026-eu-latency (internal ref 2026-06-17-01)

rita (cs): emailing affected customers now. template: "We're investigating increased latency in EU region; our team is working to restore. We'll follow up with updates. Contact support if you need immediate assistance."

sam (sre): rollback completed at 09:20 UTC. worker CPU and ready counts returning to normal. monitoring for error rates and 99th latency.

olivia (oncall): observed 99th falling back toward baseline by 09:24. continuing to monitor for 30m before close.

jordan (commops): compose 1st periodic update:

jordan (commops): ```Update 1: Rollback of a recent infra change has been completed. Metrics show improvement in worker availability and reduced 99th-percentile latency. We will continue to monitor and provide a final update once performance stabilizes. Next update: in ~20 minutes.``` 

lee (legal): looks fine.

maya (product): add short note for customers using streaming: "Consider switching to non-streaming endpoints if latency critical" — optional as a support suggestion, not necessary on statuspage now.

rita (cs): posting customer follow-up email linking update 1 and offering 1:1 for impacted enterprise customers.

incident-bot: automated metric snapshot: 99th latency for streaming endpoints in eu-west-1: 11.3s -> 4.1s after rollback.

olivia (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated" at 09:40 UTC. will wait until 10:10 UTC to confirm fully stable then publish resolved.

jordan (commops): draft resolved copy:

jordan (commops): ```Resolved: The increased generation latency issue in the EU region has been mitigated. A rollback of a recent infrastructure change restored worker availability and reduced tail latencies. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.``` 

lee (legal): tweak: remove technical rollback detail for public message. propose:

lee (legal): ```Resolved: The increased generation latency issue in the EU region has been mitigated and normal performance has been restored. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.``` 

jordan (commops): approved. will publish resolved notice at 10:12 UTC after final confirmation.

rita (cs): sending final customer note and closing impacted-tickets tag. thanks team.

sam (sre): logs show root cause: autoscaler health-check regression caused temporary node draining; follow-up PR to add stricter gating.

olivia (oncall): filing postmortem stub and assigning to sam+maya for detailed impact and follow-up. Assigning action: autoscaler gating PR + escalation test.

jordan (commops): copy of final resolved notice posted to statuspage at 10:13 UTC.

incident-bot: incident closed at 10:13 UTC. internal ref 2026-06-17-01. reactions: :white_check_mark: :eyes:

olivia (oncall): thanks everyone. good catch and quick rollback. we'll follow up in postmortem."
